title: Concept-Reversed Winograd Schema Challenge: Evaluating and Improving Robust Reasoning in Large Language Models via Abstraction

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM coreference resolution performance on an adversarial dataset (Concept-Reversed Winograd Schema Challenge), where original entities are replaced with new concepts whose strong semantic associations point toward the logically incorrect answer.

Testing whether models abandon textual logic in favor of stereotypical assumptions about certain groups or roles (e.g., assuming a 'frail senior' is universally weak, or 'elite students' are always disciplined) by tracking performance drops on concept-reversed prompts, and mitigating this using an Abstraction-of-Thought (AoT) framework.
